title: 第2591章 也许会智力受损第2590章 我不要你死
lines: 言安希只觉得眼前一黑，身子晃了晃。
好在慕迟曜及时的扶住她：“安希……”
“医生，你直说吧。”言安希深吸了一口气，“有什么都说出来，让我们有个心理准备。”
“也许，我说的是也许，什么事都没有。也许，智力会受损，变成一个只有三岁智商的孩童。又或者……失忆。”
“有没有手段可以治疗？”
医生缓缓的摇了摇头；“大脑是人体最复杂的器官。目前，没有办法，一切就靠运气了。”
最好的结果，是什么事都没有。
稍差一点的，失忆。
最差的……
智力受损，以及，永远醒不过来。
准备跟护士去验血抽血的慕念安，听到这句话，膝盖一软眼前一黑，差点晕过去。
但一想到，她还要输血给慕以言，便死命的咬着唇，咬出血来，用疼痛来让自己清醒！
那么意气风发，只手遮天，前途光明的慕以言，从来都是让人仰望的存在，如今却因为救她，躺在病床上，下半辈子也许会变成一个废人……
慕念安抬手，狠狠的扇了自己一耳光！
都怪她，半夜去散什么步！惹出这么大的麻烦！
可是现在，说什么都没用了。
抽血室里，慕念安说道：“能抽多少就抽多少，没关系的，我能承受得住。”
“你现在脸色很差。”护士说，“还按最高的标准抽血的话，只怕你会受不住。”
“没关系的，可以救他就好。”
“他是你的……”
慕念安怔了怔。
慕以言是她的谁？这个问题，要如何回答？
“他是我最爱的人。”慕念安说，“这辈子，最爱最爱的人。”
护士的眼里流露出怜悯，感动的情绪。
可怜的一对有情人啊……
抽完血，慕念安站起来卷下袖子，却忽然身子一软，倒在地上。
彻底的不省人事！
她能够撑到现在，已经很不容易了！
护士吓了一跳，立刻将她扶到病床上！
天色亮了又暗，暗了又亮。
高级病房里，慕以言躺在病床上，身上插满了管子，戴着氧气罩，闭着眼睛，没有一丝生气。
他的额头上缠绕了一圈白色纱布，那么醒目。
“如果以言真的……”言安希站在病床边，神色落寞又憔悴，“该怎么办才好。”
慕迟曜回答：“不会的，他没有这么脆弱，我相信他的意志力会战胜，会撑过来。”
言安希连哭都没有眼泪。
儿子是她的心头肉，慕念安也是她的心头肉。
她从来没有因为亲生或者不亲生的这个问题，心里的天平有所倾斜。
一直都是公正的。
“老公，公司那边，辛苦你了。”言安希说，“太累的话，不用到医院来，回家好好休息。”
“你一个人在这里，我怎么放心？”
“没关系的，我也做不了什么，只是陪着而已。”
content_en:
Yan Anxi felt her eyes go dark and her body swayed.
Fortunately, Mu Chi Yao helped her in time: "An Xi..."
"Doctor, just tell me." Yan Anxi took a deep breath, "Tell us everything so that we can be mentally prepared."
"Maybe, I mean maybe, nothing will happen. Maybe, the intelligence will be damaged and become a child with an IQ of only three years old. Or...amnesia."
"Is there any way to treat it?"
The doctor shook his head slowly; "The brain is the most complex organ in the human body. At present, there is no way, everything depends on luck."
The best result is that nothing happens.
Worse still, amnesia.
The worst…
Mentally impaired, and never wakes up.
Mu Nian'an, who was about to go for a blood test with the nurse, heard this sentence, her knees went weak, her eyes darkened, and she almost fainted.
But when she thought about having to transfuse blood to Mu Yiyan, she bit her lip until it bled, and used the pain to wake herself up!
Mu Yiyan, who is so high-spirited, covers the sky with one hand, and has a bright future, has always been a being that people look up to, but now he is lying on the hospital bed because of saving her, and may become a disabled person in the rest of his life...
Mu Nian'an raised his hand and slapped himself hard!
It's all her fault, why go for a walk in the middle of the night? Caused so much trouble!
But now, it's useless to say anything.
In the blood drawing room, Mu Nian'an said: "Pump as much as you can, it doesn't matter, I can bear it."
"You look very bad now," the nurse said. "If you still draw blood according to the highest standards, I'm afraid you won't be able to bear it."
"It's okay, just save him."
"He is yours..."
Mu Nian'an was stunned.
Who is Mu Yiyan to her? How to answer this question?
"He is the person I love most." Mu Nian'an said, "The person I love the most in this life."
The nurse's eyes showed compassion and emotion.
Poor couple...
After drawing blood, Mu Nianan stood up and rolled up his sleeves, but suddenly his body went limp and he fell to the ground.
Completely unconscious!
It’s not easy for her to hold on until now!
The nurse was startled and immediately helped her to the bed!
The sky is bright and dark, dark and bright again.
In the high-end ward, Mu Yiyan was lying on the bed, with tubes inserted into his body, an oxygen mask on, his eyes closed, lifeless.
There was a circle of white gauze wrapped around his forehead, which was so eye-catching.
"If what you say is true..." Yan Anxi stood beside the hospital bed, looking lonely and haggard, "What should I do?"
Mu Chi Yao replied: "No, he is not that fragile. I believe his willpower will overcome him and survive."
Yan Anxi didn't even cry.
Her son is her heart and soul, and so is Mu Nian'an.
She has never tilted the balance in her heart because of the question of whether she is biological or not.
Always fair.
"Honey, thank you for your hard work from the company." Yan Anxi said, "If you are too tired, you don't have to come to the hospital, just go home and have a good rest."
"How can I rest assured that you are here alone?"
"It's okay, I can't do anything, I just stay with you."
title_en: Chapter 2591 Maybe the intelligence will be damaged Chapter 2590 I don’t want you to die
